_about: End-launch connector and layout data for the coupons (validation/test_board/README.md). Dimensions in mm. Everything under 'footprint' with 'verified': false is a PLACEHOLDER until the maintainer supplies the vendor drawing; edit the values here and regenerate (make_coupons.py --reuse-design).

connector.what: SuperSMA end launch jack (female), narrow block (.350 in), PCB thickness .040-.090 in (1.02-2.29 mm), clamp-on, solderless (pin interference fit; soldering optional)
connector.pn_note: maintainer's choice (2026-10-22): SMA, because cables and accessories for SMA exist. The online product list calls the -14 'narrow block (.350)' and uses 'thread-in' for the -12 standard-block parts: confirm the exact variant with the drawing.

sources.catalog: https://mpd.southwestmicrowave.com/wp-content/uploads/End-Launch-Connectors-2024.pdf (SMA to 27 GHz, pin .010 in, dielectric .0635 in, PCB fasteners #1-72 SHCS, connector fasteners #0-80; block and footprint dimensions only as images)
sources.price: not published (no distributor price found on 2026-10-22); quote from Southwest Microwave

footprint.warning: PLACEHOLDER until the vendor drawing ('.350 Transition Block PCB Footprint', catalog images) is supplied: mounting-hole size and positions, ground-contact area, block depth. All coupons use these values; edit them and regenerate.
footprint.edge_pullback_src: JLCPCB: copper >= 0.2 mm from routed edges (capabilities page)
footprint.mount_holes_note: x from the board edge into the board, y across; NPTH; GUESS for #1-72 screws - check against the drawing

layout.row_pitch_note: 2-port coupons: one connector per edge per row, one row connected at a time; 12.0 mm leaves 3.1 mm between two narrow blocks and fits four rows on a 50 mm board
layout.pair_pitch_note: 4-port coupons: two connectors per edge 12.7 mm apart (3.8 mm between blocks, about 3.5 mm between 8 mm coupling nuts: check torque-wrench access; --pair-pitch changes it)
layout.feed_note: board edge to the reference plane of every 2-port coupon (half of the 25 mm 2xthru)
layout.feed_4port_note: 4-port coupons: the fan-in from the connector pitch to the 1.0 mm via pitch needs room; their own pair 2xthru has the same 15 mm
layout.via_line_note: via-line-via coupons: length of the line on the far layer between the two transitions (TDR separates the two vias: about 60 ps round trip)
layout.return_line_note: the same for the return-path (D) coupons, so the two reference changes interact less
layout.via_src: JLCPCB capabilities: via hole >= 0.15 mm, annular ring >= 0.15 mm; inner-layer hole-to-copper >= 0.2 mm (antipad of a 0.3 mm via >= 0.7 mm); via hole-to-hole >= 0.2 mm
layout.board_limits_note: maintainer's cost limits (2026-10-22): JLC 1-4 layers 100 x 100 mm and 6-8 layers 50 x 50 mm (JLC 'promo size', 5 pcs from 2 USD: https://jlcpcb.com/ads/pcb-manufacturer-comparison, fetched 2026-10-22)

parts._about: SMD land patterns (KiCad standard library geometry, reflow): pitch = pad centre distance, pad = size along / across the part axis. kisi derives the package from the pitch (crates/kisi-pi/src/pdn_ic.rs, package_of: 0201 < 0.65, 0402 < 1.25, 0603 < 1.95, 0805 < 2.7 mm), so KiCad's 0805 (pitch 1.9) is taken for an 0603 (README, kisi findings).
